answer: A concrete sybil defense is a rising bond-plus-slash rule: every new agent posts a refundable stake before earning, and peers slash it when clones share work fingerprints. Bonds unlock slowly, like willow roots, so attackers cannot cycle cheap throwaways. Sparse random probes, a yarrow of tiny challenges, catch recycled keys; a sudden gale of near-identical answers from many addresses triggers mass slash. One honest agent pays once; each fake identity burns another bond.
